title: Har Raat 2 Baje Wahi Ek Photo Aata Hai | Anhoni #shorts

characters.rohan: 35-year-old Indian man, oval face, medium-brown skin, tired eyes with dark circles, short black hair slightly messy, 2-day stubble; wears a wrinkled grey formal shirt with sleeves rolled up and a loose navy tie; distinctive feature: a thin healed scar above his left eyebrow.
characters.meera: 32-year-old Indian woman, round soft face, wheatish skin, long straight black hair tied in a low bun, calm watchful eyes; wears a deep maroon cotton kurta with a thin gold chain; distinctive feature: a small black bindi and a silver watch worn on her right wrist.

intro: Raat 2:14 baje phone bajta hai — aur photo mere apne ghar ki hoti hai.
music_prompt: dark cinematic suspense background music, cold creeping dread, tense, no vocals, no drums

panels.text: Ye photo... meri hi chhat se li gayi hai.
panels.prompt: Close-up of Rohan's face lit only by phone glow in a dark bedroom, sweat beading on forehead, eyes wide; wall clock behind reads 2:14; the phone screen shows a grainy photo of a sleeping man from directly above. Crumpled bedsheet, half-empty water glass.

panels.text: Isme main so raha hoon. Kal raat wala.
panels.prompt: Over-shoulder shot of the phone, Rohan's thumb zooming into the photo — it shows himself asleep, same bedsheet, same water glass. Morning light now, cold tea, a Maruti key on the table, his hand trembling slightly.

panels.text: Raat ko darwaza tune khula chhoda tha.
panels.prompt: Medium two-shot in a small kitchen, Meera at the gas stove stirring dal, back to Rohan who sits gripping his phone. Steam rising, steel tiffin, a wall calendar with three dates circled in red pen.

panels.text: Main chhat pe kabhi nahi jaata, Meera.
panels.prompt: Low-angle close-up of Rohan's uneasy face, phone light harsh from below, his loose tie hanging; behind him a locked terrace door with a rusted bolt, cobwebs on its handle, kitchen blurred.

panels.text: Police ko dikha. Mera cousin cyber cell mein hai.
panels.prompt: Wide shot of the living room, Meera calmly on a beige sofa scrolling her own phone, Rohan pacing near a barred window; evening orange light, a framed wedding photo on the wall, an unplugged landline in the corner.

panels.text: Har photo mein woh gold chain dikhti hai.
panels.prompt: Extreme close-up of the phone photo, Rohan squinting; in the corner of the top-down frame, a thin gold chain lies on the floor near the bed. His scarred eyebrow visible, dim hallway behind, brows knitting.

panels.text: Teri chain us raat kahan gayi thi?
panels.prompt: Tense over-shoulder shot facing Meera who stands still by the terrace door, a key in her hand, face unreadable; Rohan seen from behind, shoulders rigid. A shoe rack, her maroon dupatta on a hook beside them.

panels.text: Main tujhe dikhana chahti thi, khud dekh.
panels.prompt: Close-up of Meera's calm face, a faint sad smile, silver watch on her right wrist catching lamp light; behind her the terrace door now open, a stepladder against the wall, one photo taped to the frame.

panels.text: Tu... upar se meri photo kheenchti thi?
panels.prompt: Dramatic wide shot on the open terrace at dusk, Rohan stepping back near the edge, Meera standing beside a tripod with a phone clamped facing down into an open skylight over the bedroom. Water tanks, drying clothes, harsh shadow.

panels.text: Skylight ke neeche jo aadmi so raha tha — woh Rohan nahi, koi aur tha.
panels.prompt: Extreme close-up of the taped photo on the terrace door: the sleeping man's face is turned — it is NOT Rohan, a stranger in Rohan's bed wearing his grey shirt. Meera's silver watch reflects in the glossy print, clock in the distance reads 2:14.

caption:
Har raat 2:14 baje uske apne ghar ki photo aati thi... par bistar pe woh khud nahi tha. Toh Rohan roz kahan sota tha?

Part 2 ke liye Follow karo.
